title: Privacy Policy
intro: This Privacy Policy applies to the Onyx Box website and open-source projects associated with the Onyx Box.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
content: The data controller is Michał Skrzyński, creator of projects published under the Onyx Box name.

sections.title: 2. Website hosting
content: This website is hosted through GitHub Pages. GitHub may process technical data required to provide security,
correct operation and maintenance of its infrastructure.
Detailed information is available in GitHub's Privacy Statement.

sections.title: 3. No first-party tracking
content: I do not use my own tracking scripts, mailing-list forms or user databases on this website.

sections.title: 4. Cookies
content: The website does not use its own marketing cookies. Technical cookies may be used by the hosting platform where
required to provide the website correctly.

sections.title: 5. Payments and support
content: If you support my work through Buy Me a Coffee, payment data is processed directly by that external service.
I do not have access to full payment-card numbers or banking credentials.

sections.title: 6. Contact
content: For questions, contact me by e-mail or through LinkedIn.
